label: Bible Study
prompt: And Jesus saith unto him, The _____ have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
verse: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
note: Jesus to an eager would-be follower — even foxes had more of a home than he did.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do _____ among you.
verse: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.
note: The night before crossing the Jordan: get ready, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he said unto them, Take me up, and _____ me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
verse: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
note: Jonah's own solution to the storm: throw me overboard — and the sea will calm down.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Is not this the _____ that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
verse: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
note: Israel fasted and complained God didn't notice; he replied that the fast he wants is freeing the oppressed.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be _____ with power from on high.
verse: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
note: 'Tarry ye' and wait to be 'endued with power from on high' — a promise kept at Pentecost in Acts 2.
